title: 16.94. Sanidassanattika, Sauttaraduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Anidassanaappaṭighaṁ sauttaraṁ dhammaṁ paccayā nasanidassanasappaṭigho nasauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Anidassanaappaṭighaṁ anuttaraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naanidassanaappaṭigho naanuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā cha, adhipatiyā cha …pe… avigate cha.
